root_analytical_review.cumulative_transform_and_moving_Robin_dy: Accepted by direct integration in fixed material xi and y=xi^2/2.
root_analytical_review.comparison: At a positive maximum of v-M-epsilon*t the y slopes coincide, eliminating the quasilinear D argument difference; the second derivative and positive D make the interior derivative negative.
root_analytical_review.axis: v(0,t)=M(0,t)=0 excludes positive maxima at the degenerate endpoint without division by y.
root_analytical_review.outer_boundary: At a right-end maximum w_y>=0; w_t+(hm/R)w_y<=-epsilon excludes it.
root_analytical_review.initial_and_breakpoints: Continuous trace and piecewise classical positive-time equations suffice for the argument; no initial Robin compatibility is assumed. Apply segmentwise with continuous state.
root_analytical_review.global_drying_criterion: M/y at the axis bounds only center C. Center>.15 suffices to exclude every-location strict drying; no arbitrary differentiation or radial monotonicity is used.
root_analytical_review.tail_transfer: A uniform lower bound on M/y from the early quadratic barrier bounds the new cumulative tail barrier initially; no whole-field pointwise lower bound is asserted.
root_analytical_review.bound_scope: D bound applies at the barrier slope, not at all possible actual C for arbitrarily high alpha. Original no-source heat maximum principle supplies the T bound.
root_analytical_review.strict_positive_exponential: For each finite real time exp(-lambda*t)>0; floating underflow is not used for nonreachability.

conclusion: For the declared regular solution class of the original fixed/affine no-latent 1D model, alpha>=exact critical excludes whole-domain C<.15 at every finite time, including the first4h.
